content.title: Complete Messenger System Implementation - JARVIS Mode Execution
content.summary: Successfully implemented a complete, production-ready messenger system with database schema, API endpoints, WebSocket integration, and notification system. All 14 todos completed in JARVIS mode execution.
content.details: Implemented comprehensive messenger system including: Database schema with 5 Prisma models (Conversation, Message, ConversationParticipant, MessageReaction, MessageRead), 4 RESTful API endpoints for conversations and messages, WebSocket real-time integration with typing indicators and reactions, notification system integration with message received/created/reaction triggers, mobile optimization with responsive drawer interface, and comprehensive error handling. System includes real-time messaging, typing indicators, message reactions, read status, user search, and notification triggers. All features working correctly with user extremely satisfied and ready for production deployment.
